method: read-only static analysis of C:/Users/sqz269/bsp.gpr program /battlestationspacific.exe plus read-only PE scans of the on-disk image; no Ghidra mutation of any kind
headline: None of the six classes is a ship: MLandVehicle 0x740, LandConvoy 0x3CC, MLandFort 0x758, MCommandBuilding 0x7E8, MShipyard 0x7A4, MAirfield 0x8E4, against the 0x1188 ship instance.

MLandVehicle has no motion of its own: it overrides neither the tick element per-step slot (+8h stays the inherited 00953CC0) nor the per-frame update (+0DCh stays 00956600), and never reaches the ship motion controller 00825F20. Its pose is written every step by its LandConvoy from 00742400.
The shipyard does not receive message 7Ah, it sends it: 00844FC0 sets the scene property ShipYardLaunch on the new ship's bag at 008450AA, and that becomes the launched ship's +1130h.

flow_gaps.recovered: ADD ESP,4 at 0074290D and MOV dword ptr [EDI+ESI*4],0 at 00742910
flow_gaps.why_it_matters: without those ten bytes the decompiler renders a return inside the cleanup loop, which reads as a shipped memory leak (one group matrix freed, the rest and the pointer array leaked, every step). The raw bytes show the loop frees every entry and then frees the array at 00742923, so there is no leak.

names_added_note: 24 ledger name hypotheses, all through tools/bsp.py ledger add-name, none refused; no Ghidra rename, comment, prototype or save. The routines Ghidra has no function for are recorded in no_ghidra_function instead of the name ledger.
open_questions: Who consumes the airfield's EntryPath/ExitPath hangar list built at 006D5D71/006D5D96. It is the obvious producer for the plane's 'Runway on Path' taxi state, but docs/PLANE_GROUND_OPS.md has the plane reach its surface through (unit+BF4h)->+4h->+3Ch->vtable[28h] instead, and no airfield accessor call was found on that path.
Whether a LandConvoy is ever authored under a parent that is not a Landscape. The terrain law reaches the height field through parent+3D0h with no class test, so a non-landscape parent would fault.

MLandFort vtable[0A0h] 007482B0 interior 007482D0-00748986, the only place a repair or crew rule could still be hiding. No health regeneration and no crew field appears in any fort routine this packet read.
Which of the shipyard's three vectors (+770h, +780h, +790h) is the stock list and which the hangar list; only +780h is proven to be the slot vector.
MAirfield's +748h/+749h: which is the runway failure flag and which the hangar failure flag.
tool_problems: ghidra decompile renders a return inside 00742400's cleanup loop because ghidra disasm drops ten bytes after the _free at 00742908. Read as a leak from the pseudocode alone.
Ghidra has no function at 00742C10, 007410B0, 007410C0, 0074CDA0, 006D2510 or 006F7360, all of which are live vtable slots; disasm-raw was needed for each.
bsp.py show --asm --start rejects an address that is not a listing line start, and the error does not say which nearby address would work.

ghidra xrefs does not find the writers of a field, so PE displacement scans (local/scanimm.py, bsp.py scan-bytes with wildcarded modrm) were needed to find the producers of MLandVehicle's +72Ch..+734h and the convoy's +354h/+358h/+3BCh.
